inputs.role: actual square translation and compatible Galois element

roles.derivation: At finite precision the chosen Frobenius acts as C on torsion, so its square acts as identity. Its squared affine action has translation (1+C)v. Reduction of a chosen division point commutes with this action, hence the finite-field Kummer cocycle evaluated on the residue Frobenius is this same translation. Applying b with bC=b gives2b(v), retaining its fixed valuation once M exceeds that valuation.
roles.boundary: This is a fixed-point, fixed-place statement. Division-point existence, the finite torsion cocycle computation and actual good reduction are retained inputs, not consequences of Chebotarev alone.
